prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
competitors_mentioned: My pick: Big Brand Tire & Service
answer_verbatim:
**My pick: Big Brand Tire & Service** at **3687 Old Santa Rita Rd**. It’s a strong local choice for both buying and installation: the available listing shows **4.7/5 from about 700 reviews**, with customers praising clear explanations, quick service, and tire work. [Big Brand Tire](https://www.bigbrandtire.com/locations/3687-old-santa-rita-rd-pleasanton-ca-94588)

For a second quote, try **The Tire Choice**, **4216 Rosewood Rd**. Its Pleasanton listing shows about **270 reviews**, including positive reports of friendly, fast service. [The Tire Choice](https://locations.thetirechoice.com/ca/pleasanton/4216-rosewood-rd)

**Bottom line:** I’d start with Big Brand, then compare the *out-the-door* price with Tire Choice. Ask each to itemize installation, balancing, disposal, TPMS service, alignment (if needed), and any road-hazard coverage; confirm the exact tire model and appointment timing before booking. Review scores are useful signals, but they don’t guarantee a particular visit.
